title: Rock Band SCANDAL Announces Disbandment After 21 Years
content:
The official website of SCANDAL announced on Monday that the four-member all-female rock band will disband on August 21, 2027, following their final concert at the Yokohama Arena in Kanagawa Prefecture. The disbandment date will coincide with the band's 21st anniversary.

The band explained that after reaching their 20th anniversary, they held numerous discussions and felt they had fully accomplished everything they could do together as a four-member group. To conclude their journey, SCANDAL will embark on a final tour across all 47 Japanese prefectures starting October 22.

SCANDAL originally formed in August 2006 as high school students from a vocal and dance school in Osaka, performing indie gigs at Osaka Castle Park. The current lineup consists of vocalist and guitarist Ono Haruna, guitarist and vocalist Sasazaki Mami, bassist and vocalist Ogawa Tomomi, and drummer and vocalist Suzuki Rina. They made their major debut in October 2008 with the single "DOLL" under Epic Records Japan and won the New Artist Award at the Japan Record Awards in December 2009. In December 2018, the band established their private label, "her." In August 2023, SCANDAL was officially recognized by the Guinness World Records as the longest-running rock band with the same female members.

The band has been widely acclaimed for their contributions to anime music, with theme songs for Bleach , Fullmetal Alchemist: Brotherhood , Star Driver: Kagayaki no Takuto , Loups=Garous , and Pokemon Movie 17: Hakai no Mayu to Diancie .

title: Nekopara Sekai Connect Game Launches for PC on September 28
content:
The game debuted on iOS and Android devices on April 14 in English and Japanese. The game commemorates the 10th anniversary of the franchise .

Neko Works is credited for the production and editorial supervision, and Good Smile Company is credited for production and distribution. Yostar is credited for publicity cooperation.

Yui Sakakibara performs the opening theme song "Nekopara Iten."

The game series inspired a television anime series that premiered in January 2020 and ran for 12 episodes. Funimation streamed the series as it aired with both English subtitles and an English dub .

title: Crunchyroll Confirms U.S. Release Date for Major 2026 Anime Movie With New Look
content:
A major movie released in Japan earlier this year, and now Crunchyroll and Sony Pictures Entertainment have confirmed that they will soon be bringing it to the United States with an official theatrical release. The last few years have been great for anime projects in theaters, and many of them have found a lot of worldwide success thanks to a few breakthroughs that really made an impact with fans. It’s made the prospect of bringing even more anime releases to theaters soon after their initial release even more promising.

That’s the case with The Irregular at Magic High School . The anime franchise has had a lot of success with its multiple TV seasons , spinoff, and even a previous feature film release. It made its return to theaters earlier this year in Japan with a brand new film for the Yotsuba Succession Arc, and now it’s been confirmed that Crunchyroll and Sony Pictures Entertainment are going to be bringing this new movie to the United States and Canada for a limited time this November.

New The Irregular at Magic High School Movie Gets 2026 U.S. Release Date

The Irregular at Magic High School THE MOVIE -Yotsuba Succession Arc- is going to be making its debut in theaters in the United States and Canada for a very limited time with screenings on November 1st, 3rd and 4th. It’s going to be screening with both a Japanese language and English dubbed audio available. This new movie picks up right after the events of the TV anime’s third season , so you’re going to want to catch up with everything that’s happened in the anime so far now streaming with Crunchyroll in the meantime.

The Irregular at Magic High School THE MOVIE -Yotsuba Succession Arc- is directed by Jimmy Stone, and adapts the titular Yotsuba Succession Arc that takes place in Volume 16 of Tsutomu Sato’s original light novels. It’s brought to life by the same studio behind the rest of the anime franchise, Eight Bit, so it’s all going to look just as good as it did in the original TV anime. It’s also the first in a whole new wave of anime releases planned for the franchise’s near future.

What’s Next for The Irregular at Magic High School?

The Irregular at Magic High School THE MOVIE -Yotsuba Succession Arc- is funny enough, the capstone to just the first part of the long running anime franchise thus far. There’s even more on the way in the future as “Part 2” is now confirmed to be in the works. More details for the anime’s future is set to be revealed at a later date, but this second phase of the anime is likely going to continue to work through the multiple volumes of the light novels still yet to make it to screens.

The Irregular at Magic High School is certainly one of the more interesting success stories of the 2010s as while it took quite a few years before the second season actually made its debut, the franchise quickly released all sorts of projects that expanded it in many other ways like spinoffs, movies and more. It’s not slowing down anytime soon, so make sure you’re caught up with it all before November.

title: The Summer Hikaru Died Gets New Summer Seasonal Illustration by Cypic
content:
The Summer Hikaru Died anime received a new seasonal summer illustration by studio Cypic, featuring Hikaru and Yoshiki fishing together. The two main characters previously won the 2025 Best Ship or Couple award in our yearly ranking.

In the main AOTY ranking , The Summer Hikaru Died ranked 2nd overall, only being 0.09% behind the winning Takopi’s Original Sin . You can see the new illustration below.

Following its debut on July 5, 2025 the anime adaptation of The Summer Hikaru Died reached the top spot (#1) on both Netflix Japan daily rankings and ABEMA’s anime ranking. The series was co-produced by CyberAgent and KADOKAWA, with CygamesPictures (now Cypic) in charge of the animation. Netflix is streaming it worldwide. Season 2 was announced immediately after the first season’s finale.

The Summer Hikaru Died ( Hikaru ga Shinda Natsu ) is a Japanese manga series written and illustrated by Mokumokuren. It began serialization on Kadokawa Shoten’s Young Ace Up website in August 2021 and has been compiled into 8 volumes as of December 2025. The manga topped the 2023 edition of Takarajimasha’s Kono Manga ga Sugoi! list of best manga for male readers, and it was also nominated for the 16th Manga Taisho. Yen Press licensed the manga in English.

title: Shonen Jump Hit Drops New Look at Season 2’s Netflix Debut – Watch Trailer
content:
A major Shonen Jump anime hit is gearing up for its return to Netflix next year, and a new trailer is showing off a new look at what to expect from its comeback with Season 2. Netflix recently revealed a huge slate of new projects they now have in the works as the streaming service is offering all kinds of major anime releases . This includes not only anime franchises that are set to make their debut, but a number of blockbuster hits that are going to return for new episodes as well.

Sakamoto Days is one such series as the anime’s debut season made a lot of waves with the streaming service when it hit Netflix sometime ago. After previously confirming that a second season was in the works late last year , Sakamoto Days has officially set a January 2027 release window for the new episodes with a cool look teasing what’s next to come from the series before it makes its return to Netflix. You can check out the newest trailer below.

When Does Sakamoto Days Season 2 Come Out?

Sakamoto Days Season 2 will be making its debut with Netflix sometime in January 2027 as part of the Winter 2027 anime schedule, and you can catch up with the first season streaming there in the meantime. This newest trailer also reveals the first look at some of the new faces making their debut in the coming episodes with Kikunosuke Toya as Amane, Misa Watanabe as Etsuko Satoda, and Shinshu Fujii as Yotsumura all confirmed as of the time of this writing. But we’ll be seeing much more of it all in action soon enough.

Sakamoto Days had a whirlwind of a first season when it initially made its debut with Netflix. Yuto Suzuki’s original manga was a smash hit in Shonen Jump thanks to the slick way it had depicted all of its action sequences, and unfortunately the anime wasn’t able to fully bring all of those to life when it first began. But it all changed dramatically in the second half of that debut season, and continues to look even better with the upcoming second season tightening everything up too.

What’s Next for Sakamoto Days?

It’s also been a pretty huge time for the Sakamoto Days franchise overall. Because while the anime adaptation is gearing up for its return for its second season, it’s had a lot of success in theaters across Japan with an official live-action feature film adaptation . But that’s not all that has been in the cards as Suzuki’s manga series is working its way through the final battle of the series overall. And the end of the manga is fast approaching quicker than ever before.

Sakamoto Days previously confirmed it kicked off the final arc of the series earlier this year, and the latest chapters of the manga are now in the midst of its final battle against the series’ biggest villain . It’s likely going to end within a couple of more weeks, and that means that the franchise is going to have quite a lot that fans are going to want to keep an eye out for through the rest of the year and beyond.

title: New Tokyo Revengers Trailer Kickstarts Finale With Disney+ Release Date Confirm – Watch
content:
Tokyo Revengers is gearing up to kick off the anime’s grand finale, and has set a date for its Disney+ premiere with a new trailer showing off its big comeback. Ken Wakui’s Tokyo Revengers ended its original manga run some time ago, but the anime has been keeping the franchise alive with new seasons since. But that’s set to come to an end very soon as the anime is ready to adapt the penultimate arc of the series as it’s touting a final saga to the long running franchise overall.

Tokyo Revengers: War of the Three Titans Arc is the fourth season of the anime series , and is set to continue Takemichi’s struggle for the best possible future. After the end of the third season, Takemichi discovered that while he was able to save everyone else, Mikey was left in a much darker future. Now heading into the past one final time, you can check out the newest trailer for Tokyo Revengers ‘ big comeback below as it preps for its October premiere.

When Does Tokyo Revengers Season 4 Come Out?

Tokyo Revengers: War of the Three Titans Arc will be making its debut on October 2nd with Disney+ ( and Hulu and Hulu on Disney+ in the United States ) as part of the Fall 2026 anime schedule. Maki Kodaira is set to take over from Koichi Hatsumi (who is overseeing the scripts instead) and directing the new season for Liden Films. Airi Tsuyuki, Kae Takakura, Keiko Ota and Kenichi Onuki will be providing character designs, and Hiroaki Tsutsumi will be composing the music. More details have been confirmed for the anime’s return too.

The new opening theme for the season is titled “IGNITE” as performed by JO1, and the new ending theme for the series is titled “TRICK STAR ” as performed by go!go!vanillas. New additions to the voice cast to help kick off the anime’s grand finale include Naoyuki Shimozuru as Takeomi Akashi, Shinnosuke Tachibana as Wakasa Imaushi, Takanori Hoshino as Keizo Arashi, Hiroki Yasumoto as South Terano. It’s also going to be hosting a panel during the New York Comic Con 2026 weekend this October for more updates too.

How Is Tokyo Revengers Going to End?

Tokyo Revengers: War of the Three Titans is set to adapt the penultimate arc of Ken Wakui’s original manga, but the anime adaptation is touting this as a finale for the franchise overall. It’s possible we’ll see everything adapted over its episodes before it’s all said and done, but it’s yet to be revealed just how long this season is going to be sticking around for. That’s before even getting into just how divisive the original finale for the series actually is, and whether or not the anime is going to be able to take it all on.

Tokyo Revengers had one of the most divisive manga finales of a Shonen series in recent memory, and that was made even worse by the fact that the series’ time travel gimmick was making the waters even murkier towards that finale . Now that the anime is set to adapt this finale, there is a way it can be better received by fans if the adaptation can help it all make much more sense than the first go around. For now, you can catch up with the second and third seasons with Hulu in the meantime.

title: 'Tetsuryō! meet with Tetsudō Musume' Anime Premieres on October 8
content:
HIDIVE will stream the anime as it airs in the U.S., Canada, the U.K., Ireland, Australia, and New Zealand. The world premiere screened at this year's Anime NYC event on August 21.

The original anime's story centers on four train-loving college students who are members of the Tetsudō Ryokō Dōkō-kai ("Tetsuryo" in short, or literally Railway Travel Club). They journey throughout the world where hundreds of Tetsudō Musume work.

TOMYTEC is credited for the original work in collaboration with I've Been Killing Slimes for 300 Years and Maxed Out My Level novel writer Kisetsu Morita . Misuzu Hoshino ( Laid-Back Camp episode director, Hokkaido Gals Are Super Adorable! , The Maid I Hired Recently Is Mysterious director) is directing the anime at East Fish Studio . Aya Satsuki ( Solo Camping for Two , "Ippon" Again! , Too Cute Crisis ) is overseeing and writing the series scripts, and Hisanori Hashimoto ( Laid-Back Camp season 3) is designing the characters.

title: Solo Leveling: Ragnarok Is Officially Getting a New U.S Release After Finale
content:
While the Solo Leveling: Ragnarok webtoon continues its indefinite hiatus, the novel has already bid farewell to fans. Written by Daul, the series serves as the official spin-off of the original Solo Leveling franchise. It follows Jinwoo’s son, Sung Juho, in an alternate universe where he awakens his powers and fights against cosmic beings. Thanks to the popularity of the original series, Ragnarok became a massive hit after its release and continues to grow in popularity. While the Korean version of the novel ended last year, the English translation of the novel returned to Tapas earlier this month with final chapters after it went on hiatus in September last year.

However, even though the novel has also been concluded on Tapas, that’s far from the end of the series. Following Anime NYC this month, the official X handle of Ize Press confirmed that the Solo Leveling: Ragnarok novel is getting its first-ever English print in the U.S. While the release date hasn’t been confirmed in the post, we can expect an announcement by the end of the year or in the first half of 2027. In July this year, Ize Press also released the webtoon’s first volume in print, and it has already confirmed the release dates of the second and third volumes .

When Will Solo Leveling: Ragnarok Webtoon Return?

The webtoon went on an indefinite hiatus earlier this year after the second season finale. Webtoon artists often take months of breaks between seasons to prepare for the weekly serialization. However, while the hiatus between the first and second seasons wasn’t nearly long enough, Season 3 will have a major change. The reason Season 3 is taking so much longer is that the lead artist, Jin, will be replaced following his enlistment in the mandatory military service.

Since it typically lasts for 18-21 months, the publishers can’t wait that long for Jin to return. Since there haven’t been any official updates on the new artist and the webtoon’s return, it’s impossible to determine when it will return. The first two seasons are currently available on Tapas, where we can expect the upcoming season to drop after the webtoon is released in South Korea.

Solo Leveling: Ragnarok Deserves Its Own Anime

While the webtoon is still ongoing, the novel has reached its conclusion, so it’s about time it also gets an anime adaptation. Solo Leveling: Ragnarok not only introduces new characters but also brings back some of the most beloved characters from the original story to keep fans hyped.

Additionally, the series is more than popular enough, with a huge fanbase who will be thrilled to follow the journey of Jinwoo’s son. However, since the original anime hasn’t wrapped up the story yet, it’s uncertain if Ragnarok will get an anime adaptation before that. In the meantime, you can catch up with both the webtoon and novel on Tapas.

Additionally, the series is more than popular enough, with a huge fanbase who will be thrilled to follow the journey of Jinwoo’s son. However, since the original anime hasn’t wrapped up the story yet, it’s uncertain if Ragnarok will get an anime adaptation before that. In the meantime, you can catch up with both the webtoon and novel on Tapas.

title: All 4 Persona 3 Anime Films Stream on Aniplex USA YouTube Channel for Limited Time
content:
The four films are available in Japanese with English subtitles. Atlus West stated the films are available for a limited time, but did not state when the videos would be removed. The videos are available in North America, Central America, South America, the U.K., Ireland, South Africa, Australia, and New Zealand.

Aniplex of America is streaming the films for free in celebration of the 30th anniversary of the Persona series.

The first film premiered in Japan in November 2013. The second film opened in June 2014, the third film opened in April 2015, and the fourth film opened in January 2016.

Tomohisa Taguchi ( Persona 3 the Movie #2 Midsummer Knight's Dream , Persona 4 the Golden Animation ) took over as director for the fourth film at A-1 Pictures from a screenplay by Jun Kumagai with supervision by Seiji Kishi . Zenou Tanioka of Bihou, Inc. returned as art director from the second film, after Toshihiro Kohama served in that role for the third film. Junpei Takatsu was the composite and visual director. Keisuke Watabe designed the characters for the film, and Shoji Meguro and Tetsuya Kobayashi scored the soundtrack.

Aniplex of America released the first film in May 2014, followed by the second film in March 2015, the third film in January 2016, and the fourth film in August 2016.
